entries.us: Well, well, you are{BR}armed and look so brave.{PAGE}But, if you don't keep{BR}your weapons in good{PAGE}shape, they are worth{BR}nothing.{END}
entries.en: Well, well. Quite the brave getup.{BR}But gear's useless if you don't use it well!{END}

entries.jp: モタビアについて しりたいことが あったら{BR}セントラル・タワーの ライブラリに いきなよ!{END}
entries.us: If there's something you{BR}would like to know about{PAGE}Mota, you should go{BR}to the library at the{PAGE}Central Tower.{END}
entries.en: If there's something you want to know{BR}about Motavia, go to the Library{PAGE}in the Central Tower!{END}

entries.jp: ぼくは むかし みずうみの にしに ある{BR}バイオシステムで はたらいていたんだよ・・・{END}
entries.us: I used to work at the{BR}Biosystems Lab which is{PAGE}on the other side of the{BR}lake.{END}
entries.en: I used to work at the Biosystem,{BR}west of the lake………{END}

entries.jp: きたの かわの はしに ちかづいちゃいけません。{BR}あそこで なんにんものひとが{PAGE}ダラムというおとこに ころされてるのよ。{END}
entries.us: Do not get close to the{BR}bridge on the north{PAGE}river. Many people have{BR}been killed there by{PAGE}a man named Darum.{END}
entries.en: Don't go near the bridge over the northern{BR}river. Lots of people have been killed{PAGE}there by a man called Darum.{END}

entries.jp: おかねさえあれば クローン・ラボで からだを{BR}さいせいすることが できるのよ。 べんりねえ。{END}
entries.us: If you have money, you{BR}can always get your body{PAGE}cloned at the clone{BR}lab.{END}
entries.en: As long as you have money, the Clone{BR}Lab can restore your body. Convenient, huh?{END}

entries.jp: これからは おんなも ぶきを もって{BR}たたかうべきよ! わたしも かいにいくわ!{END}
entries.us: From now on, women{BR}should be armed and{PAGE}should fight! I believe{BR}in that!{END}
entries.en: From now on, women should take up arms{BR}and fight too! I'm going to buy some as well!{END}

entries.jp: おとこは なんたって ハンターが かっこいいわ!{BR}つよくて ほんと たよりになるってかんじ!{END}
entries.us: Hunters are the coolest{BR}guys. They really are{PAGE}strong and so depend-{BR}able!{END}
entries.en: When it comes to men, hunters are the{BR}coolest! They're strong, and so reliable!{END}

entries.jp: このまちは へいわだわ。 アリマーヤから{BR}ひっこしてきて ほんとうに よかった・・・{END}
entries.us: This town is peaceful.{BR}I'm glad I moved here{PAGE}from Arima.{END}
entries.en: This town is so peaceful. I'm really{BR}glad I moved here from Arimaya………{END}

entries.jp: バイオシステムのおかげで モタビアは さかえた。{BR}だが そのバイオシステムがつくった モンスターが{PAGE}モタビアを あらしているのだから うんめいとは{BR}ひにくなものじゃのう・・・{END}
entries.us: Thanks to the Biosystems{BR}Lab, Mota flourished.{END}
entries.en: Motavia prospered thanks to the Biosystem.{BR}Yet now the monsters that same Biosystem{PAGE}made are ravaging Motavia. Fate can be{BR}cruelly ironic, eh………{END}

entries.jp: このところ ぜんぜん あめが ふらん。{BR}みずうみも かれはててしまった。{END}
entries.us: It hasn't rained at{BR}all for awhile. The{PAGE}lake even dried up.{END}
entries.en: It hasn't rained at all lately.{BR}The lake has dried up, too.{END}

entries.jp: うちのパパは まいにち ブラブラしてるよ。{BR}はたらかなくても いきていけるからって。{END}
entries.us: My dad is just goofing{BR}off everyday.{PAGE}He says he can live{BR}without working.{END}
entries.en: My dad just lazes around every day.{BR}He says he can get by without working.{END}

entries.jp: まじめに はたらくって バカみたいなことなの?{BR}おとなは みんな そんなこと いってるよ?{END}
entries.us: Why should I work for{BR}a living?{END}
entries.en: Is working hard a dumb thing to do?{BR}That's what all the grown-ups say.{END}

entries.jp: ぼく、おおきくなったら どろぼうに なるんだ!{BR}いま はやりの しょくぎょうだもんね。{END}
entries.us: When I grow up, I'm{BR}going to be a Thief.{END}
entries.en: When I grow up, I'm going to be a thief!{BR}It's a trendy job right now.{END}

entries.jp: きたのはしにいくと ダラムってやつに{BR}おかねを とられちゃうんだって。{END}
entries.us: They say that if you go{BR}to the north bridge, a{PAGE}guy named Darum will{BR}rob you of your money.{END}
entries.en: They say if you go to the north bridge,{BR}some guy called Darum will rob you.{END}

entries.jp: あなた、いったいなぜ このアリマーヤに きたの。{BR}ここは ひどいところよ。{END}
entries.us: Why in the world did{BR}you come to Arima?{PAGE}This is such a horrible{BR}place!{END}
entries.en: Why on earth did you come to Arimaya?{BR}This is a terrible place.{END}

entries.jp: このまちに ならずものが やってこなかったら{BR}ダラムと ティムの おやこは しあわせに{PAGE}くらしていけたのに・・・{END}
entries.us: If only those scoundrels{BR}hadn't come to this{PAGE}town, Darum and his{BR}daughter Teim could have{PAGE}lived a happy life.{END}
entries.en: If those thugs had never come to town,{BR}Darum and his daughter Tiem could have{PAGE}lived happily together………{END}

entries.jp: モンスターより おそろしいのは にんげんだわ。{END}
entries.us: What's most frightening{BR}is humans, not monsters.{END}
entries.en: People are more terrifying than monsters.{END}

entries.jp: このまちは ならずものたちに おそわれて{BR}もう なんにも のこってないわ・・・{END}
entries.us: This town has been wiped{BR}out by the scoundrels,{PAGE}and there's nothing{BR}left.{END}
entries.en: Thugs attacked this town, and{BR}now there's nothing left………{END}

entries.jp: ならずものたちは ダイナマイトで ひとびとの{BR}いえを こわしていった・・・{END}
entries.us: Those scoundrels blew up{BR}everyone's houses{PAGE}with dynamite!{END}
entries.en: Those thugs blew up people's houses{BR}with dynamite………{END}

entries.jp: ならずものたちは まだ あと 2つの{BR}ダイナマイトを もっていたはずじゃ。{PAGE}とりもどさないと、また まちが{BR}こわされてしまう・・・{END}
entries.us: The scoundrels must{BR}have two more dynamite{PAGE}sticks. Unless we take{BR}them away, another town{PAGE}will be destroyed.{END}
entries.en: The thugs should have two more sticks{BR}of dynamite left.{PAGE}If we don't get them back, they'll{BR}destroy a town again………{END}

entries.jp: ならずものたちは いつも ひがしのほうから{BR}やってくる。 あの あさやけにうかぶ やつらの{PAGE}シルエットの なんと おそろしいことか・・・{END}
entries.us: Those scoundrels always{BR}come from the east.{END}
entries.en: Those thugs always come from the east.{BR}How terrifying their silhouettes look{PAGE}against the morning glow………{END}

entries.jp: ならずものは、おとこを みなごろしにし、おんなを{BR}さらっていき、しょくりょうを うばっていった。{END}
entries.us: The scoundrels stole all{BR}the food, killed all the{PAGE}men, and kidnapped all{BR}the women.{END}
entries.en: The thugs slaughtered the men, carried{BR}off the women, and stole all our food.{END}

entries.jp: ここに のこされたのは ちからのないものばかり。{BR}うえて しぬのを ただ まつだけじゃ。{END}
entries.us: Those who are left here{BR}are just the powerless,{PAGE}who are only waiting to{BR}die.{END}
entries.en: The only ones left here are the weak.{BR}We're just waiting to starve to death.{END}

entries.jp: ぼく しってる! ならずものたちのアジトは{BR}シュレーンの たてものの なかだよ。{END}
entries.us: I know! The hideout of{BR}those scoundrels is at{PAGE}a building in Shure.{END}
entries.en: I know! The thugs' hideout is inside{BR}the building in Shuren.{END}

entries.jp: わるいやつらは ようじんぶかくて、かぎをかけた{BR}コンテナに にもつを しまいこんでるんだって。{END}
entries.us: I hear that those bad{BR}guys are very cautious,{PAGE}and keep their stuff in{BR}a locked container.{END}
entries.en: They say those crooks are cautious, and{BR}keep their loot in locked containers.{END}

entries.jp: ダラムのおじさんは わるいひとじゃない!{BR}らんぼうものになったのは ティムちゃんが{PAGE}さらわれちゃったからだよ!{END}
entries.us: Darum is not a bad guy!{BR}The reason he became{PAGE}violent is that his{BR}daughter, Teim, was{PAGE}kidnapped!{END}
entries.en: Mr. Darum isn't a bad man! He only turned{BR}violent because little Tiem was kidnapped!{END}

entries.jp: ここは オプタノ。 バイオシステムは このまちの{BR}みなみにあるよ。{END}
entries.us: This town is called{BR}Opta. The Biosystems{PAGE}Lab is located in the{BR}southern part of this{PAGE}town.{END}
entries.en: This is Optano. The Biosystem is{BR}south of this town.{END}

entries.jp: バイオシステムが モンスターをつくっちゃった?{BR}そんなの うそに きまってるさ。{END}
entries.us: The Biosystems Lab{BR}created the monsters?{PAGE}That's a lie.{END}
entries.en: The Biosystem made the monsters?{BR}That's got to be a lie.{END}

entries.jp: バイオシステムは あめがすくないところでも{BR}よくそだつ しょくぶつを つくってきたんですよ。{END}
entries.us: The Biosystems Lab had{BR}been creating plants{PAGE}which grow well even in{BR}a land with little rain.{END}
entries.en: The Biosystem has been making plants{BR}that grow well even with little rain.{END}

entries.jp: バイオシステムは マザーブレインが コントロール{BR}してるんだ。 まちがいなんか おこりっこない!{END}
entries.us: The Biosystems Lab is{BR}controlled by Mother{PAGE}Brain. It cannot make{BR}mistakes!{END}
entries.en: Mother Brain controls the Biosystem.{BR}There's no way mistakes could happen!{END}

entries.jp: 「ほしのかおりは きずをいやし{BR}つきのかおりは たましいを よみがえらせる。」{PAGE}むかしの きぞくたちは こんなことをいって{BR}アトマイザーを つけていましたっけ。{END}
entries.us: STAR MIST cures your{BR}scars, and MOON DEW{PAGE}revives your soul.{END}
entries.en: "The scent of stars heals wounds;{BR}the scent of the moon revives the soul."{PAGE}So the nobles of old used to say{BR}as they used their atomizers.{END}

entries.jp: ああ マザーブレインさま!{BR}わたしたちを おすくいください!{END}
entries.us: Oh, glorious{BR}Mother Brain!{PAGE}Please save us!{END}
entries.en: O, Great Mother Brain!{BR}Please save us!{END}

entries.jp: モンスターが いなくなったところで モタビアは{BR}もう めちゃくちゃよ。 どうしようもないわ。{END}
entries.us: Even if those monsters{BR}are gone, Mota has{PAGE}already been devastated.{BR}There's nothing we can{PAGE}do.{END}
entries.en: Even with the monsters gone, Motavia's{BR}already in shambles. Nothing can be done.{END}

entries.jp: ねえ、アトマイザーって しってる?{BR}とても いいかおりが するのよ。{PAGE}でも アトマイザーは とても ぜいたくなもの。{BR}めったに てに はいらないのよねえ。{END}
entries.us: Say, have you heard of{BR}STAR MIST and MOON DEW?{PAGE}They smell very good.{END}
entries.en: Say, do you know about atomizers?{BR}They smell so lovely.{PAGE}But atomizers are a real luxury.{BR}You hardly ever get your hands on one.{END}

entries.jp: わたし おんがくかに なりたいの。 このまちに{BR}ピアノのせんせいが いるってきいたんだけど・・・{END}
entries.us: I want to be a musician.{BR}I heard that there's a{PAGE}piano teacher in this{BR}town.{END}
entries.en: I want to be a musician. I heard there's{BR}a piano teacher in this town………{END}

entries.jp: バイオシステムの たてものの まんなかの あなは{BR}あの おそろしい ちかしつに つうじているのだ。{END}
entries.us: The hole in the middle{BR}of the Biosystems Lab{PAGE}building leads to that{BR}horrible basement.{END}
entries.en: The hole in the middle of the Biosystem{BR}building leads to that terrifying basement.{END}

entries.jp: バイオシステムの ちかしつ・・・{BR}そこには なにか もっとも たいせつなものが{PAGE}あるらしい・・・{END}
entries.us: In the basement of the{BR}Biosystems Lab, I hear{PAGE}there is something most{BR}important.{END}
entries.en: The basement of the Biosystem………{BR}Something of the utmost importance{PAGE}seems to be down there………{END}

entries.jp: おなかがすいた・・・{END}
entries.us: I feel hungry.{END}
entries.en: I'm hungry………{END}

entries.jp: モタビアは いったい いつになったら{BR}へいわに なるのかしら。{END}
entries.us: I wonder when peace will{BR}return to Mota?{END}
entries.en: I wonder when Motavia will finally know{BR}peace?{END}

entries.jp: パルマのひとたちは すききらいが あるから{BR}おなかが すくんだ。{END}
entries.us: People of Algo are{BR}hungry all the time{PAGE}because they can't{BR}eat anything.{END}
entries.en: The people from Palma are picky eaters,{BR}so they go hungry.{END}

entries.jp: ぼくたち おなかがすいたら なんでもたべるよ。{END}
entries.us: We eat anything when we{BR}get really hungry.{END}
entries.en: When we're hungry, we'll eat anything.{END}

entries.jp: ねー。マザーブレインって なに?{BR}それって おいしい?{END}
entries.us: Hey, what's{BR}Mother Brain?{END}
entries.en: Hey, what's Mother Brain?{BR}Does it taste good?{END}

entries.jp: ここは ゼマ。みずうみのほとりのリゾートタウン。{END}
entries.us: This is Zema, a resort{BR}town by the lake.{END}
entries.en: This is Zema, the resort town{BR}by the lake.{END}

entries.jp: モタビアンが のりものにのって あそんでいるのを{BR}みたことがあるよ。 たのしそうだったなあ。{END}
entries.us: I remember seeing{BR}Mota people playing on{PAGE}a mobile machine.{END}
entries.en: I've seen Motavians riding around{BR}on a vehicle. It looked like fun!{END}

entries.jp: あんたは みなみのはんとうに いったことある?{BR}あのあたりは ロロンから ゴミのにおいが{PAGE}ただよってきて くさいのよー。{END}
entries.us: Have you been to the{BR}southern peninsula?{PAGE}That area smells ter-{BR}rible because of the{PAGE}garbage smell from{BR}Roron.{END}
entries.en: Have you been to the southern peninsula?{BR}The smell of garbage drifts over from{PAGE}Roron. It stinks!{END}

entries.jp: モタビアンはね、ガラクタでもって なんでも{BR}つくってしまうの。{END}
entries.us: Mota people make{BR}anything from junk.{END}
entries.en: Motavians can make anything out of junk.{END}

entries.jp: モタビアンたちは ロロンの ごみすてばが{BR}だいすきなの。 いつもあそこで あそんでるわ。{END}
entries.us: Mota people love the{BR}garbage dump in Roron.{END}
entries.en: The Motavians love the Roron garbage{BR}dump. They're always playing there.{END}

entries.jp: みずうみの なかほどに だれもいったことがない{BR}タワーがあるの。 あれは なにかしら?{END}
entries.us: Around the middle of the{BR}lake, there's a tower{PAGE}where nobody has ever{BR}been.{END}
entries.en: In the middle of the lake there's a tower no{BR}one has ever been to. I wonder what it is?{END}

entries.jp: わしらも わかいころは ジェットスクーターで{BR}うみで あそんだもんじゃ。{END}
entries.us: We used to play in the{BR}ocean on a jet scooter{PAGE}when we were young.{END}
entries.en: When we were young, we used to play{BR}on the sea with jet scooters, too.{END}

entries.jp: テレポート・サービスが できてからは のりものを{BR}つかうひとは いなくなったんじゃ。{END}
entries.us: People stopped using{BR}any mobile machines{PAGE}after the teleport{BR}service was introduced.{END}
entries.en: Once the Teleport Service came along,{BR}nobody used vehicles any more.{END}

entries.jp: なんじゃ?{END}
entries.us: What the………?{END}
entries.en: What's that?{END}

entries.jp: はあ?!{END}
entries.us: What?{END}
entries.en: Huh?!{END}

entries.jp: このまちの ひとびとの そせんは うみで{BR}はたらいていたのですよ。{END}
entries.us: The ancestors of the{BR}people in this town{PAGE}used to work in the{BR}ocean.{END}
entries.en: The ancestors of the people in this{BR}town worked out at sea, you know.{END}

entries.jp: このまちには うみについて いろんないいつたえが{BR}のこっています。{END}
entries.us: In this town, there are{BR}many stories about the{PAGE}ocean.{END}
entries.en: All sorts of legends and stories about the{BR}sea are still told in this town.{END}

entries.jp: うみと みずうみは じめんの したで{BR}つながってるんだって。 ほんとかなあ。{END}
entries.us: They say the ocean and{BR}the lake are connected{PAGE}under the ground.{END}
entries.en: They say the sea and the lake are joined{BR}underground. I wonder if that's true.{END}

entries.jp: クエリスへ ようこそ。{END}
entries.us: Welcome to Kueri.{END}
entries.en: Welcome to Kueris.{END}

entries.jp: むかしのひとは さかなを とるのに{BR}なにかを たべて うみに もぐったらしいわ。{END}
entries.us: They say people in the{BR}old days used to eat{PAGE}something before going{BR}under the ocean.{END}
entries.en: They say people long ago would eat{BR}something before diving to catch fish.{END}

entries.jp: わたしのかれは まちはずれに すんでるの。{BR}けんきゅうの じゃまを されないようにって。{END}
entries.us: My boy friend lives on{BR}the outskirts of the{PAGE}town, so that nobody{BR}disturbs his work.{END}
entries.en: My boyfriend lives on the edge of town,{BR}so nobody gets in the way of his research.{END}

entries.jp: うみのみずのいろが ちがうところでは{BR}みずうみのみずが わきでているんですって。{END}
entries.us: In the places where the{BR}color of the water is{PAGE}different in the ocean,{BR}they say it's because of{PAGE}water from the lake.{END}
entries.en: Where the sea water's a different color,{BR}they say lake water is welling up.{END}

entries.jp: モタビアの うみには ウーゾという なまえの{BR}いわだらけの しまが あったはずじゃが。{END}
entries.us: I remember there was a{BR}rocky island named Uzo{PAGE}in the ocean.{END}
entries.en: There should be a rocky island called{BR}Uzo out in the Motavian sea.{END}

entries.jp: マザーブレインの おたっしにより うみにいくのが{BR}きんしになったのは 50ねんまえの ことじゃ。{END}
entries.us: It was 50 years ago when{BR}Mother Brain prohibited{PAGE}people from going to{BR}the ocean.{END}
entries.en: It was fifty years ago that Mother Brain{BR}decreed no one may go out to sea.{END}

entries.jp: ねえ、ロロンの ぼくたちの なかまには{BR}もう あった?{END}
entries.us: Hey, have you met our{BR}friends in Roron?{END}
entries.en: Hey, have you met our friends{BR}in Roron yet?{END}

entries.jp: あー、にんげんだー。こわーい。{END}
entries.us: Oh, no! Humans!{END}
entries.en: Aah, a human! Scary!{END}

entries.jp: あなたは しっていましたか? うちゅうへ たびを{BR}することが もう ありえないってことを。{END}
entries.us: Did you know that it is{BR}impossible to travel to{PAGE}outer space now?{END}
entries.en: Did you know? Traveling through space{BR}just isn't possible any more.{END}

entries.jp: 10ねんまえに じこが あって うちゅうせんは{BR}ぜんぶ つかわれないことに なったんですよね。{END}
entries.us: After the accident of{BR}10 years ago, the use{PAGE}of any spaceship has{BR}been prohibited.{END}
entries.en: There was an accident ten years ago, and{BR}all spaceship use was since prohibited.{END}

entries.jp: スぺースポートが あったころは ひっきりなしに{BR}パルマや デゾリスへ ふねが とんだものです。{END}
entries.us: There used to be space-{BR}ships taking off for{PAGE}Palm and Dezo one{BR}after another, when{PAGE}there was a spaceport.{END}
entries.en: Back when the spaceport was functional,{BR}ships flew to Palma and Dezolis constantly.{END}

entries.jp: オレ、パイロットを めざしてたんだけど{BR}うちゅうせんが ないんじゃ なれっこないよな。{END}
entries.us: I wanted to be a pilot,{BR}but I guess I can't be{PAGE}one since there is no{BR}spaceship.{END}
entries.en: I wanted to be a pilot, but with no{BR}spaceships, I guess that won't happen.{END}

entries.jp: このまちは ピアタ。 むかしは このちかくに{BR}スぺースポートが あったのよ。{END}
entries.us: This town is called{BR}Piata. There used to{PAGE}be a spaceport near{BR}here.{END}
entries.en: This town is Piata. Long ago there{BR}was a spaceport near here, you know.{END}

entries.jp: 10ねんまえの じこというのは デゾリスのうえで{BR}うちゅうせんどうしが しょうとつしたことよ。{END}
entries.us: When people refer to the{BR}accident of 10 years{PAGE}ago, they mean the col-{BR}lision of spaceships{PAGE}over Dezo.{END}
entries.en: The accident ten years ago was when two{BR}spaceships collided above Dezolis.{END}

entries.jp: 10ねんまえの じこでは ものすごく たくさんの{BR}ひとが しんだらしいわ。{END}
entries.us: They say a number of{BR}people got killed in the{PAGE}accident of 10 years{BR}ago.{END}
entries.en: They say a huge number of people{BR}died in the accident ten years ago.{END}

entries.jp: うちゅうを たびすることは ちっとも きけんじゃ{BR}ないって みんな しんじていたのに。{END}
entries.us: Everyone used to believe{BR}that travelling in space{PAGE}was not dangerous at{BR}all.{END}
entries.en: Everyone believed that space travel{BR}wasn't dangerous at all.{END}

entries.jp: さいごの うちゅうせんは アルゴルのそとを{BR}めざして いたのじゃ。{END}
